Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Software Coordinator Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIM Kozhikode) for hiring eligible candidates on a contract basis in Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The organization is offering the post of Software Coordinator under advertisement number C-79/2026-IIMK.HR for qualified and experienced professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Software Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Software Coordinator position in this recruitment cycle at IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIM Kozhikode Software Coordinator recruitment is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Software Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/BE/MCA/M.Sc/MS or BCA/BSc/Diploma in relevant engineering or computer science disciplines along with the specified post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Software Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Software Coordinator post is 30 years as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Software Coordinator post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,300/-, which includes Rs. 300 towards telephone allowance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications exclusively through online mode by visiting the official website of the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Software Coordinator position comprises a practical test followed by a personal interview administered by the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply link?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to download the official notification PDF and access the online application portal in the Important Links section above.
